description: pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:204 and crl.rs:57-70: the dual semantics of Ok(()) ('not revoked' OR 'not covered by this CRL's IDP') are documented on CrlChecker but not on the RevocationChecker trait's check_revocation method. A caller implementing their own revocation aggregator will read the trait doc, see Ok(()) = not revoked, and conclude that a single Ok(()) from any checker is sufficient. The security implication (hard-fail callers must verify coverage separately) must be in the trait doc, not just the impl doc.
notes: lib.rs:212 already has an explicit 'Ok(()) dual semantics' paragraph in the trait doc. No change needed.
title: CrlChecker.check_revocation Ok(()) dual semantics undocumented at trait level
